question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Doleful
solution:
The correct answer is "**Joyous.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Doleful" means sad or mournful**.(मातमी)

 
 
• Example: His face looks doleful when he is not smiling.
 
 
 
• **Joyous means happy or cheerful. **(आनंदित)
 
 
• Example: It was a joyous occasion.
 
 
 
 
 
• Antonym is a word that means the opposite of another word.
 
• Therefore, Joyous is the antonym of Doleful.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, Worthless, means having no value or importance.(बेकार)
 
• Option 3, Horrid, means extremely unpleasant or offensive.(भयंकर)
 
• Option 4, Dismal, means depressing or dreary.(निराशाजनक)
